$comment: The Pact Broker the harness's broker fixtures run against (staged plan S1.3): the Ruby broker's own image, by digest. .github/scripts/pact-broker.sh starts exactly this image, and the harness refuses a broker reporting another version unless told to. Moving it can move the disagreement ledger, so it is a deliberate change: take the digest of the new tag from Docker Hub, and rerun.
